result.topic_en: Gauss works a numerical example of the arithmetic-geometric mean sequences, extended backwards from a=5, b=2, and shows that the AGM is homogeneous: M(ka,kb)=k M(a,b), so M(a,b)=aM(1,b/a)=bM(a/b,1).
